title: Gauntlet cases for grounding, Italian and English
goal: A pack case checks the model's Eva entry names only the day's facts, in each language
acceptance: Two cases (one Italian, one English) in the Gauntlet on invented days: the entry cites every recorded source, invents no source, base or pilot, and stays in the requested language; the Italian case is written as the owner would read it, not translated
A case with a thin day (one fact) checks the entry stays short and still grounded
Follows the Gauntlet's existing case format and ledger; nothing runs against the live model in CI
privacy: Neutral invented bases, pilots, sorties and days only; no owner data, tokens or real conversation text in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: two cases and one thin-day case on the existing format. Not a measurement.
